title: Signal workshop catalog and heatmap strategy
body:
Overview:
This is the workshop output capturing candidate operational signals, a proposed heatmap-based prioritization strategy, lightweight dashboard microcard templates, and a tracing anchor plan for multi-model inference flows. The intent: leave the session with a 6-week instrumentation sprint backlog (low-effort high-impact items up-front) and a sampling strategy that respects query-cost budgets.

Goals:
- Make it clear which signals directly reduce SRE or oncall time-to-detect or time-to-repair.
- Prioritize signals by operator effort, query cost, and debugability (trace anchorability).
- Provide 2x compact dashboard microcards for common operator tasks (latency triage, cold-cache investigation).
- Define a bounded adaptive sampling plan and a cost-aware alerting envelope.

Signal catalog (candidate metrics) — short-name : intent / owner / query-hint / cardinality / suggested-alert
- session_warmth_index : detect cold-session-dominated latency spikes / owner: Jordan Li / hint: rollingavg(prefix_hits_per_session,10m) / low-card / alert: p95>baseline+200ms for 5m
- prefix_cache_miss_rate : KV/prefix cache miss fraction for each model variant / owner: Maya Patel / hint: sum(kv_miss)/sum(kv_lookup) by model,variant / med-card / alert: rate increase >3x baseline over 15m
- per_token_cpu_proxy : approximate per-token CPU cycles (host_cpu_time / tokens_generated) / owner: Samuel Ortiz / hint: use compute-agg logs, divide by output_tokens / high-card per-node / alert: p90 rising trend >30%
- continuity_gap_count : count of truncated/resumed responses (indicative of backend fallback) / owner: Priya Nair / hint: count where response.flags contains 'resumed' / low-card / alert: >5% of sessions
- multi_model_fanout_depth : number of downstream model calls per original request / owner: eng-platform / hint: trace attribute fanout_depth / low-card / alert: >expected threshold
- tenant_cost_share : per-tenant token cost share adjusted for batching / owner: finance-eng / hint: allocate batch cost pro-rata by token count / med-card / alert: none (informational)
- kvcache_eviction_rate : eviction events per minute by node / owner: infra / hint: sum(evictions) by node / high-card / alert: sustained > baseline*2
- prompt_rewrite_rate : percentage of requests rewritten by preprocessor / owner: devexp / hint: count(rewrites)/count(requests) by route / low-card / alert: sudden change >50%

Metric definitions: more formal notes (to be used when instrumenting SQL/metrics pipeline):
- prefix_cache_miss_rate = 100 * sum(kv_cache_miss_events) / nullif(sum(kv_cache_lookups),0) grouped by model, variant, region
- session_warmth_index = sum(prefix_hits_last_24h) / nullif(sum(unique_prefixes_seen_last_24h),1) (higher means warmer)
- per_token_cpu_proxy = sum(container_cpu_millis) / nullif(sum(generated_output_tokens),1) aggregated by node-type and model family
- continuity_gap_count = count_if(response_event, response_event.has_flag('continuity_gap'))

Tracing anchor plan (guiding principles):
- Keep a single trace-id per external request; propagate through orchestrator and into model runtime and pre/post processing.
- Add span tags: request.route, model.variant, tenant_id, batch_id, kvcache_hit(boolean), fanout_depth(int).
- Anchor spans for: preprocessor (rewrite), router (route decision), kvcache lookup, model-inference (per model), postprocess & streamer.
- For multi-model fanout flows, include span.parent hints that indicate the upstream request id and the local fanout index so traces can reconstruct the DAG.
- Sampling: always sample full traces for: 1) any request that triggers an alert rule in the last 10m, 2) 1 in 100 standard requests, 3) 1 in 10 requests that hit a cold cache (kvcache_miss). This keeps costs predictable while capturing edge cases.

Dashboard microcard templates (compact cards for operator consoles):
- Latency triage microcard (single-row): title: "Latencies (live)" KPIs: p50, p90, p99 for inference, queue, and end-to-end; drop-down to filter by model family; quick-links: open last 10 traces, open related alert. Visual: sparkline of p95 overlayed with request rate.
- Cold-cache investigator microcard: title: "Cache warmth & miss rate" KPIs: prefix_cache_miss_rate, session_warmth_index, kvcache_eviction_rate by node; table of top-10 tenants by miss-rate with sample traces button.

Heatmap prioritization strategy (quadrants):
X-axis = operator effort to instrument (low->high)
Y-axis = operational ROI on MTTR (low->high)
Color overlay = query-cost impact (green=low, red=high).
Prioritize top-left: low effort high ROI and low cost. Items that are high ROI but high cost should be batched into synthetic probes or lower-frequency aggregation windows.

Sampling and query-budget rules:
- Target metrics query budget: start with 2% of total observability cost for this sprint.
- Use aggregation windows for high-card signals (e.g., per-tenant token counts) instead of raw per-request logs.
- Where full cardinality is required for debugging, rely on trace sampling to capture full context rather than high-card metrics.

Alerting guidance (practical):
- Prefer relative-change alerts with cooldowns for token-serving workloads (example: alert when p95 latency increases by 30% vs baseline for 10m).
- For cardinal signals (per-tenant), use tiered alerting: page on tenant-global breach if >=5% tenants exceed threshold; otherwise, create an ops ticket.
- Quantile alerts: avoid alerting directly on p99 unless backed by p50/p90 regressions — p99 is noisy. Use p95+trend as primary.

Operational runbook snippets (copyable):
- If prefix_cache_miss_rate spikes: check kvcache_eviction_rate -> check node CPU/p99 inference -> look at session_warmth_index by tenant -> if eviction high, consider cache size bump or shed low-priority tenants.
- If multi_model_fanout_depth increases unexpectedly: check recent deploys for orchestrator change -> inspect rewrite logs for preprocessor -> open traces filtered by fanout_depth>expected.

Open questions / TODOs from workshop:
- Decide baseline windows for p95 comparisons (1h vs 24h) — action: Sam to prototype both and compare false-positive rates.
- Where should tenant_cost_share live (billing pipeline vs telemetry)? Finance needs near-real-time for reporting. Action: Maya + Finance sync.
- Feasibility check: compute per_token_cpu_proxy at 1s granularity without doubling logging cost. Action: infra to estimate cardinality cost.

Next steps (6-week sprint plan):
Wk1: Implement prefix_cache_miss_rate + session_warmth_index (low-effort high-impact) + dashboard microcards prototype.
Wk2: Trace tagging standard doc + implement basic span propagation across orchestrator.
Wk3-4: Add per_token_cpu_proxy sampling & kvcache_eviction_rate alarms; start tenant_cost_share PoC.
Wk5: Run synthetic heatmap probe to validate alert thresholds.
Wk6: Retrospective, move signals that passed validation into metric contracts and add to onboarding kit.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Keep dashboards under "observability/microcards" folder and avoid huge multi-panel dashboards for oncall view.
- Tie regression alerts to a small prompt set for ML-quality signals (cross-ref: github PR above).
- Keep sampling policy easy to override per-tenant for debugging long-running incidents.

Attachments to add: sample SQL snippets for metrics, span tag spec, dashboard JSON snippets (to be added to linked PR).

Owner: Maya Patel
Reviewers: Jordan Li, Samuel Ortiz, Priya Nair
